active_pareto_acquisition.scoring_equation: a(x,f)=EHVI_proxy(x;P_ref) * P_feasible(x) * I(f) / cost(x,f) + lambda_u*sigma(x) + lambda_r*workflow_risk_coverage(x) + lambda_d*design_diversity(x) - lambda_v*violation_risk(x)

independent_feedback_coverage_plan.coverage_rule: evaluate all promoted candidates plus the union of baseline and ablation-selected holdouts before using external feedback for policy superiority claims

constraints.model_objective_boundary: pre_l1_candidate_ordering_only; L1 workflow model and later multi_fidelity feedback remain authoritative for promotion

Cal_t(f).meaning: calibration value of the next evaluator

D_t(x).meaning: batch design diversity over architecture, mapping, schedule, memory, and residency axes

R_w(x).meaning: workflow-risk coverage across host control, post-processing, data lifetime, and transfer synchronization

steps.operation: Load QE input/log/profile/save-dir descriptors and normalize source provenance.
Extract compute, control, communication, data-object lifetime, and correctness-observable features.
Generate architecture, mapping, schedule, residency, memory, offload-boundary, and microarchitecture candidates.
Evaluate every screenable candidate with the analytical workflow model.
Select diverse seed candidates before relying on a learned residual model.
Fit or update residual and rank models from observed multi-fidelity feedback.
Score joint (candidate, fidelity) actions with the WAMF acquisition function.
Admit selected actions to the next evaluator without expanding into a closure matrix.
Update Pareto frontier, residual calibration, rank quality, and uncertainty.
Return selected deployment candidates and downstream HLS/Vivado package inputs.

symbol_table.y_f(x,w): objective vector observed or predicted at fidelity f

surrogate.graph_backend_contract: graph-aware scalar features map to heterogeneous_qe_workflow_candidate_graph nodes, edges, data objects, and candidate knobs

explanation.architecture_template: CPU keeps orchestration while selected accelerator kernels reduce hotspot time
explanation.data_residency: retains checkpointed data between workflow phases while allowing CPU-owned control
explanation.memory_topology: models external DDR streaming as a conservative baseline memory topology
explanation.offload_boundary: covers a multi-stage hotspot bundle and amortizes transfers across workflow phases
explanation.runtime_schedule: overlaps DMA with accelerated compute and hides part of movement latency
explanation.workload_basis: kernel phase weights, workflow dependencies, data_object_lifetime, host_control_events, and correctness_observables extracted from QE workflow cases
